question: The expression 3 sec<sup>2</sup> θ tan<sup>2</sup> θ + tan<sup>6</sup> θ – sec<sup>6</sup> θ is equal to:
question_hi: समीकरण 3 sec<sup>2</sup> θ tan<sup>2</sup> θ + tan<sup>6</sup> θ – sec<sup>6</sup> θ बराबर है:
solution:
Shortcut Trick

Put θ = 0° as the expression is independent of θ.

tan 0° = 0 and sec 0° = 1

Expression = 3(1)2(0)2 + (0)6 − (1)6

⇒ 0 + 0 − 1 = −1

∴ The correct answer is −1.

Alternate Method

Given: 3 sec2 θ tan2 θ + tan6 θ − sec6 θ

Formula Used: (a − b)3 = a3 − b3 − 3a2b + 3ab2 = a3 − b3 − 3ab(a − b)

⇒ We know that sec2 θ − tan2 θ = 1

⇒ Cubing both sides: (sec2 θ − tan2 θ)3 = 13

⇒ (sec2 θ)3 − (tan2 θ)3 − 3 sec2 θ tan2 θ (sec2 θ − tan2 θ) = 1

⇒ sec6 θ − tan6 θ − 3 sec2 θ tan2 θ (1) = 1

⇒ sec6 θ − tan6 θ − 3 sec2 θ tan2 θ = 1

⇒ Multiply the entire equation by −1:

⇒ −sec6 θ + tan6 θ + 3 sec2 θ tan2 θ = −1

∴ The correct answer is −1.

Additional Information

Trigonometric Identities

Standard Pythagorean identities: sin2θ + cos2θ = 1; 1 + tan2θ = sec2θ; 1 + cot2θ = cosec2θ.

Value Substitution Method

For expressions independent of the angle, substituting standard angles like 0°, 45°, or 90° (where defined) provides the fastest solution.

Algebraic Expansion

Expansion of (x − y)3 as x3 − y3 − 3xy(x − y) is frequently used in higher-power trigonometric simplifications.

question: If a + b + c = 7 and ab + bc + ca = –6, then the value of a<sup>3</sup> + b<sup>3</sup> + c<sup>3</sup> – 3abc is:

question: Two chord AB and CD of a circle are produced to intersect each other at a point P outside the circle. If AB = 7 cm, BP = 4.2 cm and PD = 2.8 cm, then the length of CD is:
question_hi: AB और CD वृत्त की दो जीवा है जो वृत्त के बाहर एक दूसरे को प्रतिच्छेदित करती हैं। यदि AB = 7 सेमी, BP = 4.2 सेमी और PD = 2.8 सेमी है, तो CD की लंबाई है:
solution:
Given,

PB = 4.2 cm and AB = 7 cm

PD = 2.8 cm and Let CD = x.

AP × PB = PC × PD

⇒ x + 2.8 = (11.2 × 4.2)/2.8

⇒ x + 2.8 = 16.8

⇒ x = 16.8 – 2.8

⇒ x = 14 cm

question: A cylindrical vessel of radius 30 cm and height 42 cm is full of water. Its contents are emptied into a rectangular tub of length 75 cm and breadth 44 cm. The height (in cm) to which the water rises in the tub is: (Take π = 22/7)
question_hi: एक बेलनाकार बर्तन जिसकी त्रिज्या 30 सेमी और ऊंचाई 42 सेमी है वह पानी से भरा है। उस पानी को आयताकार टब में खाली किया जाता है जिसकी लंबाई 75 सेमी और चौड़ाई 44 सेमी है। उस टब में पानी की ऊँचाई (सेमी में) है: ( π ​​= 22/7 रखने पर)
solution:
Radius of cylindrical vessel r = 30 cm

Height of cylindrical vessel h = 42 cm

Length of rectangular tub L = 75 cm

Breadth of rectangular tub B = 44 cm

Le the height of the rectangular tub be H cm

As we know,

Volume of cylindrical vessel = πr2h

The volume of rectangular tub = L × B × H

According to the question

75 × 44 × H = (22/7) × 30 × 30 × 42

⇒ H = (22 × 30 × 30 × 6)/(75 × 44)

⇒ H = 36
solution_hi:
बेलनाकार आकृतियों का त्रिज्या r = 30 सेमी 

बेलनाकार बर्तन की ऊँचाई h = 42 सेमी 

आयताकार टब की लंबाई L = 75 सेमी 

आयताकार टब की चौड़ाई B = 44 सेमी 

माना आयताकार टब की ऊँचाई H सेमी है

बेलनाकार बर्तन का आयतन= πr2h

आयताकार टब का आयतन = L × B × H

प्रश्नानुसार

75 × 44 × H = (22/7) × 30 × 30 × 42

⇒ H = (22 × 30 × 30 × 6)/(75 × 44)

⇒ H = 36

question: The income of A is 60% less than that of B, and the expenditure of A is equal to 60% of B’s expenditure. If A’s income is equal to 70% of B’s expenditure, then what is the ratio of the saving of A and B?
question_hi: A की आय B की तुलना में 60% कम है, और A का व्यय B के व्यय के 60% के बराबर है। यदि A की आय B के खर्च के 70% के बराबर है, तो A और B की बचत का अनुपात क्या है?
solution:
Let the income of B be Rs. 5x

income of A is 60% less than that of B

(100 - 60)/100 = 2/5

Income of A = 5x × (2/5) = Rs. 2x  

Let the expenditure of B be Rs. 5y

expenditure of A is equal to 60% of B’s expenditure

60/100 = 3/5

Expenditure of A = 5y × (3/5) = 3y

According to the question

2x = 5y × (70/100)

⇒ 2x = y × (7/2)

⇒ 4x = 7y

⇒ x : y = 7 : 4

Savings of A = 2x – 3y = 2 × 7 – 3 × 4 = 14 – 12 = 2

Savings of B = 5x – 5y = 5 (7 – 4) = 5 × 3 = 15

∴ Ratio of savings A to B = 2 : 15
solution_hi:
माना B की आय 5x रु. है।

A की आय= 5x × (2/5) = 2x रु.

माना B का व्यय 5y रु. है।

A का व्यय = 5y × (3/5) = 3y

प्रश्नानुसार

2x = 5y × (70/100)

⇒ 2x = y × (7/2)

⇒ 4x = 7y

⇒ x : y = 7 : 4

A की बचत = 2x – 3y = 2 × 7 – 3 × 4 = 14 – 12 = 2

B की बचत= 5x – 5y = 5 (7 – 4) = 5 × 3 = 15

∴ A और B की बचत का अनुपात= 2 : 15

question: In ΔPQR, ∠Q = 85° and ∠R = 65°. Points S and T are on the sides PQ and PR, respectively such that ∠STR = 95° and the ratio of the QR and ST is 9 : 5. If PQ = 21.6 cm, then the length of PT is:

⇒ QR/TS = PQ/PT

⇒ 9/5 = 21.6/PT

question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 740. After two successive discounts of 15% and x%, it is sold for Rs. 566.10. What is the value of x?
question_hi: एक वस्तु का अंकित मूल्य 740 रु. है। 15% और x% के दो क्रमिक छूट के बाद, इसे 566.10 रु. में बेचा जाता है। तो x मूल्य क्या है?
solution:
MP of the article = Rs. 740

After getting 15% discount the first SP of the article = 740 × (85/100) = 629

Second SP of the article = Rs. 566.10

Second discount = 629 – 566.10 = 62.9

∴ Second discount percentage = (62.9/629) × 100 = 10%

∴ दूसरा छूट प्रतिशत = (62.9/629) × 100 = 10%

question: If 30x<sup>2</sup> – 15x + 1 = 0, then what is the value of 25x<sup>2</sup> + (36x<sup>2</sup>)<sup>–1</sup>?
question_hi: यदि 30x<sup>2</sup> – 15x + 1 = 0 है तो 25x<sup>2</sup> + (36x<sup>2</sup>)<sup>–1</sup> का मान क्या है?
solution:
30x2 – 15 x + 1 = 0

Divide by 6x

5x – 15/6 + 1/6x = 0

⇒ 5x + 1/6x = 5/2

Squaring on both sides

(5x + 1/6x)2 = (5/2)2

⇒ 25x2 + 1/36x2 + 2 × 5x × 1/6x = 25/4

⇒ 25x2 + 1/36x2 + 5/3 = 25/4

⇒ 25x2 + 1/36x2 = 25/4 – 5/3

⇒ 25x2 + 1/36x2 = 55/12

question: The ratio of boys and girls in a group is 7 : 6. If 4 more boys join the group and 3 girls leave the group, then the ratio of boys to girls becomes 4 : 3. What is the total number of boys and girls initially in the group?
question_hi: एक समूह में लड़कों और लड़कियों का अनुपात 7: 6 है। यदि 4 और लड़के समूह में शामिल होते हैं और 3 लड़कियां समूह छोड़ती हैं, तो लड़को से लड़कियों का अनुपात 4: 3 हो जाता है। शुरू में समूह में लड़कों और लड़कियों की कुल संख्या क्या है?
solution:
The ratio of boys and girls in a group is = 7x : 6x

According to the question

(7x + 4)/(6x – 3) = 4/3

⇒ 3 (7x + 4) = 4 (6x – 3)

⇒ 21x + 12 = 24x – 12

⇒ 24x – 21x = 12 + 12

⇒ 3x = 24

⇒ x = 24/3 = 8

∴ Number of boys and girls in the group were = 7x + 6x = 13x = 13 × 8 = 104

question: In ΔABC, D and E are the points on sides AC and BC, respectively such that DE || AB. F is a point on CE such that DF ∥ AE. If CE = 6 cm, and CF = 2.5 cm, then BC is equal to:

question: A and B, working together, can complete a work in d days. Working alone, A takes (8 + d) days and B takes (18 + d) days to complete the same work. A works for 4 days. The remaining work will be completed by B alone, in:
question_hi: A और B, एक साथ काम करने पर, किसी कार्य को d दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। अकेले A वह काम करने में (8 + d) दिन और B  उस कार्य को पूरा करने में (18 + d) दिन लगाता है। A, 4 दिन काम करता है। शेष कार्य अकेले B कितने दिनों में पूरा कर लेगा?

question: If the 6–digit numbers x35624 and 1257y4 are divisible by 11 and 72, respectively, then what is the value of (5x – 2y)?
question_hi: यदि 6 अंकों की संख्या x35624 और 1257y4 क्रमशः 11 और 72 से विभाज्य हैं, तो (5x - 2y) का मान क्या है?
solution:
Concept used:

Divisibility law of 11: If the difference of the alternating sum of digits of the number is a multiple of 11 (e.g. 2343 is divisible by 11 because 2 – 3 + 4 – 3 = 0, which is a multiple of 11).

Divisibility law of 8 ⇒ A number is divisible by 8 if the number formed by its last three digits is divisible by 8

Divisibility law of 9 ⇒ A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 9.

Calculation:

The 6–digit numbers x35624 is divisible by 11, then

⇒ x – 3 + 5 – 6 + 2 – 4 = 0

⇒ x + 7 – 13 = 0

⇒ x = 6

The 6–digit number 1257y4 is divisible by 72, so we can say that the number is also divisible by 8 and 9, then

⇒ 1 + 2 + 5 + 7 + y + 4

⇒ 19 + y

If we put y = 8, then the number becomes 27 which is divisible by 9.

⇒ 5x – 2y

⇒ 5 × 6 – 2 × 8

⇒ 30 – 16

⇒ 14

The answer is 14.

question: PRT is a tangent to a circle with centre O, at the point R on it. Diameter SQ of the circle is produced to meet the tangent at P and QR is jointed. If ∠QRP = 28°, then the measure of ∠SPR is:
question_hi: केंद्र O वाले एक वृत्त की स्पर्शरेखा PRT उस पर बिंदु R स्पर्श करती है। वृत्त का व्यास SQ, इससे निकली रेखा P पर स्पर्शरेखा से मिलती है और QR जुड़ जाते हैं। यदि ∠QRP = 28° है, तो SPR का माप है:
solution:
∠QRP = 28°

As we know,

∠ORP = 90° [tangents at R]

⇒ ∠ORQ = ∠ORP – ∠QRP = 90° – 28° = 62°

⇒ ∠OQR = ∠ORQ = 62° [OQ = OR = radius]

As we know,

∠OQR = ∠ QRP + ∠QPR

⇒ 62 = 28 + ∠QPR

⇒ ∠QPR = 62 – 28 = 34

⇒ ∠SPR = ∠QPR = 34

question: The total revenue of the company from the sale of products B, C and D in 2014 is what percentage of the total revenue from the sale of products C and D in 6 years?
question_hi: वर्ष 2014 में उत्पाद B, C और D की बिक्री से कंपनी की कुल आय, 6 वर्षों में उत्पादों C और D की बिक्री से कुल आय का कितना प्रतिशत है?
solution:
Total revenue of the company from the sale of products B, C and D in 2014 = 92 + 96 + 92 = 280

Total revenue of the company from the sale of products C and D in 6 years = 82 + 98 + 96 + 88 + 93 + 103 + 74 + 102 + 92 + 93 + 97 + 102 = 1120

There are 2 years in which the revenue of the company from the sale of product D is more than the average revenue from the sale of product A over six years.

∴ Required Percentage = (280/1120) × 100 = 25%
solution_hi:
वर्ष 2014 में उत्पाद B, C और D की बिक्री से कंपनी की कुल आय = 92 + 96 + 92 = 280

6 वर्षों में उत्पादों C और D की बिक्री से कंपनी की कुल आय  = 82 + 98 + 96 + 88 + 93 + 103 + 74 + 102 + 92 + 93 + 97 + 102 = 1120

यहाँ ऐसे 2 वर्ष हैं जिनमें उत्पाद D की बिक्री से कंपनी की आय, 6 वर्षों में उत्पाद A की बिक्री से कुल औसत आय से अधिक है।

∴ अभीष्ट प्रतिशत = (280/1120) × 100 = 25%

question: One–third of goods are sold at a 15% profit, 25% of the goods are sold at a 20% profit and the rest at a 20% loss. If the total profit of Rs. 138.50 is earned on the whole transaction, then the value (in Rs.) of the goods is:
question_hi: एक तिहाई सामान को 15% लाभ पर बेचा जाता है, 25% सामान को 20% लाभ पर बेचा जाता है और शेष 20% हानि पर बेचा जाता है। यदि पूरे लेनदेन पर 138.50 रुपये कुल लाभ होता है तो सामान का मूल्य (रुपये में) है:
solution:
Given:

One–third of goods are sold at a 15% profit

25% of the goods are sold at a 20% profit

The rest at a 20% loss

Concept used:

Profit from each part = quantity × profit percentage

Calculation:

Let the total number of articles be 120.

Let the cost price of 120 articles be 120 unit

1/3rd of 120 = 40 and 1/4th of 120 = 30 and Rest = 120 – 40 – 30 = 50

Total profit = 40 × (15/100) + 30 × (20/100) – 50 × (20/100) = 6 + 6 – 10 = 2 unit

2 unit = 138.50

⇒ 1 unit = 69.25

⇒ 120 unit = 69.25 × 120 = Rs. 8310
solution_hi:
दिया गया है:

एक तिहाई सामान 15% लाभ पर बेचा जाता है

25% सामान 20% लाभ पर बेचा जाता है

शेष 20% की हानि पर बेचा जाता है

प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

प्रत्येक भाग से लाभ = मात्रा × लाभ प्रतिशत

गणना:

मान लीजिए वस्तुओं की कुल संख्या 120 है।

मान लीजिए 120 वस्तुओं का क्रय मूल्य 120 इकाई है

120 का 1/3 = 40 और 120 का 1/4 = 30 और शेष = 120 - 40 - 30 = 50

कुल लाभ = 40 × (15/100) + 30 × (20/100) - 50 × (20/100) = 6 + 6 - 10 = 2 इकाई

2 इकाई = 138.50

⇒ 1 इकाई = 69.25

⇒ 120 इकाई = 69.25 × 120 = 8310 रुपये

question: The difference in compound interest on a certain sum at 10% p.a. for one year, when the interest is compounded half-yearly and yearly, is Rs. 88.80. What is the simple interest on the same sum for \(1\frac{2}{3}\) years at the same rate?
question_hi: एक निश्चित राशि पर 10% प्रति वर्ष की दर से एक वर्ष के चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज के बीच का अंतर 88.80 रु. होता है जब ब्याज अर्धवार्षिक और वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित किया जाता है। उसी दर पर \(1\frac{2}{3}\) वर्षों के लिए समान राशि पर साधारण ब्याज क्या होगा?
solution:
Shortcut Trick

Difference in effective interest rate for 1 year = (5 × 5) / 100 = 0.25%.

0.25% of Sum = Rs. 88.80 ⇒ 100% of Sum (Principal) = 88.80 × 400 = Rs. 35,520.

Simple Interest for 12/3 (or 5/3) years = (35,520 × 10 × 5/3) / 100.

Required SI = 35,520 ÷ 6 = Rs. 5,920.

∴ The correct answer is Rs. 5,920.

Alternate Method

Given: Rate (R) = 10% p.a., Time (T) = 1 year, Difference in CI = Rs. 88.80.

Formula Used: CI = P[(1 + r/n)nt − 1]; SI = (P × R × T) / 100.

⇒ Case 1 (Yearly): CI1 = P × 10% = 0.10P

⇒ Case 2 (Half-yearly): Rate = 5%, Periods = 2; CI2 = P[(1 + 0.05)2 − 1] = 0.1025P

⇒ Difference = 0.1025P − 0.10P = 0.0025P

⇒ 0.0025P = 88.80 ⇒ P = 88.80 / 0.0025 = 35,520

⇒ For SI: T = 5/3 years, R = 10%

⇒ SI = (35,520 × 10 × 5/3) ÷ 100 = 35,520 × 50 ÷ 300

⇒ SI = 35,520 ÷ 6 = 5,920

∴ The correct answer is Rs. 5,920.

Additional Information

Half-Yearly Compounding

When interest is compounded half-yearly, the annual rate is divided by 2 (R' = R/2) and the time is multiplied by 2 (n = 2T).

Difference for Two Periods

The difference between CI and SI for two periods is given by P × (R/100)2, where R is the rate per period.

Effective Rate Method

For two successive changes of a% and b%, the effective change is (a + b + ab/100)%. This is useful for Compound Interest calculations.
solution_hi:
Shortcut Trick

1 वर्ष के लिए प्रभावी ब्याज दर में अंतर = (5 × 5) / 100 = 0.25%.

राशि का 0.25% = Rs. 88.80 ⇒ राशि (मूलधन) का 100% = 88.80 × 400 = Rs. 35,520.

12/3 (या 5/3) वर्षों के लिए साधारण ब्याज = (35,520 × 10 × 5/3) / 100.

आवश्यक SI = 35,520 ÷ 6 = Rs. 5,920.

∴ सही उत्तर Rs. 5,920 है।

Alternate Method

दिया गया है: दर (R) = 10% वार्षिक, समय (T) = 1 वर्ष, CI में अंतर = Rs. 88.80.

प्रयुक्त सूत्र: CI = P[(1 + r/n)nt − 1]; SI = (P × R × T) / 100.

⇒ स्थिति 1 (वार्षिक): CI1 = P × 10% = 0.10P

⇒ स्थिति 2 (अर्ध-वार्षिक): दर = 5%, अवधियाँ = 2; CI2 = P[(1 + 0.05)2 − 1] = 0.1025P

⇒ अंतर = 0.1025P − 0.10P = 0.0025P

⇒ 0.0025P = 88.80 ⇒ P = 88.80 / 0.0025 = 35,520

⇒ SI के लिए: T = 5/3 वर्ष, R = 10%

⇒ SI = (35,520 × 10 × 5/3) ÷ 100 = 35,520 × 50 ÷ 300

⇒ SI = 35,520 ÷ 6 = 5,920

∴ सही उत्तर Rs. 5,920 है।

Additional Information

अर्ध-वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि

जब ब्याज अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है, तो वार्षिक दर को 2 से विभाजित किया जाता है (R' = R/2) और समय को 2 से गुणा किया जाता है (n = 2T)।

दो अवधियों के लिए अंतर

दो अवधियों के लिए CI और SI के बीच का अंतर P × (R/100)2 द्वारा दिया जाता है, जहाँ R प्रति अवधि की दर है।

प्रभावी दर विधि

a% और b% के दो क्रमिक परिवर्तनों के लिए, प्रभावी परिवर्तन (a + b + ab/100)% होता है। यह चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज की गणना के लिए उपयोगी है।

question: The average weight of some students in a class was 58.4 kg. When 5 students having the average weight 62.8 kg joined the class, the average weight of all students in the class increased by 0.55 kg. The number of students initially in the class, were:
question_hi: एक कक्षा में कुछ विद्यार्थियों का औसत भार 58.4 किलोग्राम था। जब 62.8 किलोग्राम भार वाले 5 विद्यार्थी कक्षा में शामिल हुए, तब कक्षा के सभी विद्यार्थियों का औसत  भार  0.55 किलोग्राम बढ़ गया। प्रारंभ में कक्षा में विद्यार्थियों की संख्या कितनी थी?
solution:
Let the total students in the class be x, then

Average weight of x students in the class = 58.4

Sum of weight of x students in the class = 58.4x

Average weight of 5 students = 62.8 kg

Sum of weight of 5 students = 62.8 × 5 = 314

According to the question

58.4x + 314 = (x + 5) (58.4 + 0.55)

⇒ 58.4x + 314 = (x + 5) 58.95

⇒ 58.4x + 314 = 58.95x + 294.75

⇒ 58.95x – 58.4x = 314 – 294.75

⇒ 0.55x = 19.25

⇒ x = 19.25/0.55

⇒ x = 35

Short Trick:

Let total number of students be x after joining 5 students, then

0.55x = 5 (62.8 – 58.4)

⇒ x = (5 × 4.4)/0.55

⇒ x = 40

question: The time taken by a boat to travel 13 km downstream is the same as time taken by it to travel 7 km upstream. If the speed of the stream is 3 km/h, then how much time (in hours) will it take to travel a distance of 44.8 km in still water?
question_hi: एक नाव द्वारा धारा के अनुकूल 13 किमी तय करने में जितना समय लेता है उतने ही समय में वह नाव धारा के प्रतिकूल 7 किमी  दूरी तय करता है। यदि धारा की गति 3 किमी/घंटा है, तो स्थिर जल में 44.8 किमी की दूरी तय करने में कितना समय (घंटों में) लगेगा?
solution:
Speed of the stream = 3 km/hr

Let speed of the boat be x km/hr

As we know,

Time = Distance/Speed

According to the question

13/(x + 3) = 7/(x – 3)

⇒ 13 (x – 3) = 7 (x + 3)

⇒ 13x – 39 = 7x + 21

⇒ 13x – 7x = 21 + 39

⇒ 6x = 60

⇒ x = 60/6 = 10

So, speed of boat = 10 km/hr

∴ Time taken to cover 44.8 km distance in still water = 44.8/10 = \(4\frac{{12}}{{25}}\)
